# Custom (EIP-1193)

## Overview

The [`custom`](/docs/transports/custom) transport wraps an
[EIP-1193](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-1193)-compatible provider as a
[Transport](/docs/transports). The provider must have a `request` method.

Use it with injected wallets, provider libraries, or your own provider.
[`Provider.from`](/docs/utilities/provider/from) from `viem/utils` normalizes provider errors.

```ts twoslash
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"a188a7f35110d5cbbddcaaf89a38463098a42ec83ce5762b6aba96babbac6e57","data":""}
import { custom } from 'viem'

const transport = custom({
  async request({ method, params }) {
    // ...
    return null
  },
})
```

## Recipes

### Wrapping an Existing Provider

Any object with an EIP-1193 `request` method works, such as an injected wallet provider or one from a provider library.

```ts twoslash
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"58b0fbfb261e1de41501002b6a6d884a6bcfe27db0787e48dea5610ccc62d560","data":""}
import { custom } from 'viem'
import 'viem/window'

const transport = custom(window.ethereum!) // [!code focus]
```

### Restricting RPC Methods

Limit a custom provider to specific RPC methods when it should only handle part of your request flow.

```ts twoslash
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"cd3b131f50daa9b237d9fe7c3d29314b9cbd3618bfe0875a26bdc6a1fc22a950","data":""}
import { custom } from 'viem'
import 'viem/window'

const transport = custom(window.ethereum!, {
  methods: { include: ['eth_call'] }, // [!code focus]
})
```

### Configuring Retries

Tune retry behavior when the wrapped provider needs a different retry budget or backoff delay.

```ts twoslash
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"85d17ee2b98c72e4f06bf3687bd5ef701f806aab5bee4175359af98c3a3998b5","data":""}
import { custom } from 'viem'
import 'viem/window'

const transport = custom(window.ethereum!, {
  retryCount: 5, // [!code focus]
  retryDelay: 200, // [!code focus]
})
```

## `custom`

Creates a transport from an EIP-1193-compatible provider.

### Usage

```ts twoslash
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"a188a7f35110d5cbbddcaaf89a38463098a42ec83ce5762b6aba96babbac6e57","data":""}
import { custom } from 'viem'

const transport = custom({
  async request({ method, params }) {
    // ...
    return null
  },
})
```

### Parameters

#### provider

- **Type:** `{ request(...args): Promise<any> }`

An EIP-1193-compatible provider.

```ts twoslash
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"cf5a3902107c41c6ee97e5423a797a1758d722782635a7d53463f5dad34edcd7","data":""}
import { custom } from 'viem'
import 'viem/window'
// ---cut---
const transport = custom(window.ethereum!) // [!code focus]
```

#### options.key

- **Type:** `string`
- **Default:** `'custom'`

Transport key.

```ts twoslash
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"1977112b0246dbc7519bf14a79f97da2650705d1d7fea9029ad87426bf549356","data":""}
import { custom } from 'viem'
import 'viem/window'
// ---cut---
const transport = custom(window.ethereum!, {
  key: 'custom', // [!code focus]
})
```

#### options.methods

- **Type:** `{ include?: string[] } | { exclude?: string[] }`

RPC methods to include or exclude.

```ts twoslash
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"0ac354d1b436a158c0eb6f5f3bba0f4a5992cc7616c4ae1ece130e90f913a3e1","data":""}
import { custom } from 'viem'
import 'viem/window'
// ---cut---
const transport = custom(window.ethereum!, {
  methods: { include: ['eth_call'] }, // [!code focus]
})
```

#### options.name

- **Type:** `string`
- **Default:** `'Custom Provider'`

Transport name.

```ts twoslash
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"2d0d20dca31599593d4e4726b9906f13b06491fa65111c029e524ddddd9ca28d","data":""}
import { custom } from 'viem'
import 'viem/window'
// ---cut---
const transport = custom(window.ethereum!, {
  name: 'Custom Provider', // [!code focus]
})
```

#### options.retryCount

- **Type:** `number`
- **Default:** `3`

Max retries per request.

```ts twoslash
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"b4e8620973a0b8621095b9f441d2707c4db056695fffc89bed003b0ed347bd66","data":""}
import { custom } from 'viem'
import 'viem/window'
// ---cut---
const transport = custom(window.ethereum!, {
  retryCount: 5, // [!code focus]
})
```

#### options.retryDelay

- **Type:** `number`
- **Default:** `150`

Base delay (ms) between retries.

```ts twoslash
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"ad0b2e106d7d0fc3aff4f3fa94e95e5125cc56c6b939bde1b22691c76a6dea2a","data":""}
import { custom } from 'viem'
import 'viem/window'
// ---cut---
const transport = custom(window.ethereum!, {
  retryDelay: 200, // [!code focus]
})
```

### Return Value

`Transport<'custom'>`

A custom transport that delegates each request to the provider.
